description: L00 reflected across y = 0: y -> -y, yaw -> -yaw, and the cart's crossing phase shifted by pi so its initial direction mirrors too. Geometric difficulty is identical by construction, so a success-rate drop between L00 and L02 cannot be a difficulty effect -- it is direct evidence of layout-specific memorisation.
name: l02_dynamic

obstacles.label: storage rack
obstacles.purpose: Blocks part of the aisle and forces a lateral deviation. Its flat 2.4 m face is the primary lidar calibration target: a plane returns a predictable range profile, unlike a cylinder.

obstacles.label: crate stack
obstacles.purpose: Stacked pallet load off the route. Tests whether clearance is kept while converging on the goal, and gives a short wide return.

obstacles.label: powered transfer cart
obstacles.purpose: The dynamic hazard. Crosses the aisle perpendicular to the direction of travel at constant speed, so free space in its lane is a function of time and the policy must solve a timing problem, not only a geometric one.
